in_hebrew.name: עֲלוֹדְיָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עלודיה - שם-משפחה יהודי שמקורו בעברית, שנועד לתאר נושא שעבר בשלבי גידול. השם נמצא בכתובי-עתיקים, כגון בספר יחזקאל (Ezekiel 33:1), וכן בחקר המשנה. נושא דומה נמצא גם בספר תהילים (Psalms 90:5).

in_greek.name: Ἀλοδία
in_greek.meaning: ἀλόδια - feminine noun, derived from αλός, meaning 'bud' or 'growing thing'
in_greek.long_meaning: ἀλόδια - feminine noun, derived from αλός, meaning 'bud' or 'growing thing', found in ancient Greek literature, including in the Septuagint translation of the Hebrew Bible. This name may be associated with the concept of growth and development in Christian tradition.

in_latin.name: Alodia
in_latin.meaning: derived from Greek αλοδία, a feminine noun meaning 'bud' or 'growing thing'
in_latin.long_meaning: derived from Greek αλοδία, a feminine noun meaning 'bud' or 'growing thing', a name with possible connections to Christian tradition and the concept of spiritual growth. Historically, the name may have been influenced by the Latin word 'alodium', meaning 'inheritance' or 'property'.
